answers.answer: I build end-to-end Bronze/Silver/Gold (medallion) pipelines on Azure Databricks using PySpark, Delta Live Tables, and Structured Streaming, ingesting from Azure Event Hub and Kafka and orchestrated with Azure Data Factory. Core tools: Azure Data Factory, Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions for CI-CD.

My cloud data warehousing experience is on the Azure stack — Azure Synapse and Microsoft Fabric (OneLake / Lakehouse) — where I migrated 25 legacy Analysis Services models and delivered roughly 3x query-performance gains. The SQL, dimensional modeling, and ELT patterns transfer directly to Snowflake, Redshift, or BigQuery, and I ramp up quickly on new warehouse engines.

I build observability notebooks and medallion-layer data-quality scorecards with automated validation, and alert through Azure DevOps and Logic Apps. On failure I triage from the failing layer and safely replay from the last good Delta checkpoint, relying on Delta Lake ACID guarantees to avoid partial or duplicate data.

I have implemented equivalent transformation frameworks using PySpark and Delta Live Tables on Databricks — modular, testable transformations with automated quality checks and lineage. The dbt model / test / lineage approach maps closely to what I already do, and I can adopt dbt quickly.
Yes. I built Structured Streaming ingestion on Databricks from Azure Event Hub and Kafka into Delta Live Tables, moving financial reporting from a T+2 lag to near-real-time delivery.

I build medallion-layer quality scorecards, lineage documentation, and automated audit trails that raised data trust from 68% to 94%. For compliance I automated SOX MUAR audits reconciling 2M+ monthly transactions at 99.97% accuracy, and applied row-level security and GDPR data classification across 8 markets.
